mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 0.5% month-over-month signals robust consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:RSAFS correlates with consumer spending growth
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate increase above 0.5% for two consecutive months signals monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Strong labor market precedes equity gains
failure_condition: The joint movement of UNRATE falling and PAYEMS rising fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 0.5% month-over-month during supply expansion regimes indicates manufacturing output strength, improving corporate margins and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% month-over-month during supply expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 0.2% month-over-month signals inflationary pressure, triggering discount rate increases and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 9.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market recovery, increasing consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 9.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand strength, accelerating corporate revenue growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In low-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 2.0% annually), a decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative policy, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is below 2.0% annually and FEDFUNDS declines.
